title: XORA Technical Whitepaper v1.2
notes: First-party technical material describing XORA as a custodial XRP yield protocol, shared XRPL treasury and per-user destination-tag accounting, native XRPL deposit/withdrawal flows, tiered yield accounting, and a bootstrap treasury subsidy distinct from future XRPL AMM/lending sources.

title: Where XORA yield comes from
notes: First-party disclosure stating that the current native XRP yield is subsidized from a finite XORA treasury reserve, that rates are variable, and that XRPL AMM and on-chain lending allocations are later transition stages rather than current established yield sources.

title: Terms of Service
notes: First-party June 2026 terms stating that supported deposited balances are held in custodial wallets managed by XORA, APY rates are estimates rather than guarantees, and withdrawal limits or holds may be imposed for security and compliance purposes. The terms do not clearly resolve legal or beneficial ownership of deposited assets for CYA's terms-risk taxonomy.

title: XORA Launches XRP Neobank Letting Holders Earn On and Spend Their XRP
notes: Distributed launch release describing XORA as Stockholm-based, led by founder/CEO Joren Lundgren, and live since February 2026. CYA uses this for operating-origin and launch-period context, not as proof of a legal incorporation entity.

title: XORA TVL and treasury methodology
notes: Independent protocol database identifying XORA as a custodial XRPL savings product and attributing treasury address rhbErkS2d4H82tRbdGyFkhhc4LNtjKaC3o, with destination-tag routing and internal per-user accounting.

title: XORA Finance XRPL payment verification — 2026-08-12
publisher: Crypto Yield Archive reproducible XRPL probe
notes: Public repository provenance for the reproducible Ripple full-history account_tx probe. It scanned the XORA-attributed treasury history and found exactly one successful delivered-amount match for 29,899.8 XRP: transaction 4FD202B3DB7ADCA94ABDF3CC06762A3B2DD615532E13B531B1737E14788C09AA, ledger 105566760, destination tag 287588244, validated 2026-07-13T09:02:02Z.

title: Claimant post publishing two explanations after XORA withdrawal issue
notes: Claimant-published post with screenshots. One image depicts a DM interface labeled Xora Finance / @xora_finance tying destination tag 287588244 to a manual AML hold and also shows a Binance 29,899.8 XRP withdrawal matching the independently reproduced transaction; another depicts a conflicting phishing/no-account explanation. CYA does not treat the screenshots as authenticated XORA internal records.

title: XORA Finance – My XRP Withdrawal Timeline
notes: Claimant's public chronology of the XORA withdrawal dispute, explicitly framed by the claimant as a factual account seeking a technical explanation rather than as a conclusive wrongdoing determination.

title: RippleXity XORA Finance investigation notice
notes: Third-party investigation notice stating that its review began after the claimant reported a 29,899.8 XRP deposit and inaccessible funds. This is retained as attributed investigation context, not as CYA's own risk classification.

title: XORA Finance: An Investigation Into Withdrawal Issues
notes: Third-party investigation compiling multiple reported withdrawal issues, transaction observations and conflicting account explanations. CYA treats its conclusions as attributed investigative analysis and independently verifies only the XRPL facts used in the canonical record.
